policy: A catalogue card shows an Editorial plate unless an entry here is status "admitted" and passes every check in core/catalogue_media.py. A matching article cover, Signal Veil or curated-manifest route is never permission for this surface. Flipping an entry to "held" returns that card to a plate and changes nothing else.
reviewer: IPR engineering review, Phase 3B (Claude); Nos. 8 and 9 approved and No. 10 held by independent review of PR #418 (2026-10-12). Catalogue surface only; settles no wider image right.
receipt_limit: The receipt verifies licence, creator and description of the Commons original. It does not prove the re-encoded local file derives from it. No publisher-site retrieval was made.

entries.reason: Not cleared for the catalogue. Public domain (Commons: Roberto Villa Jr, U.S. Marine Corps), but the photograph shows identifiable, named U.S. and PLA officers at a 25 June 2012 Marine Corps Base Hawaii visit. It was selected automatically by keyword for an unrelated subject (the Brief is about two former defence ministers' sentences). Beside that headline a card can read as identification. The sidecar alt text is the file name, and the opened article's disclaimer is too long for a card. The opened-article use is unchanged and not assessed here. Clear only with an owner-reviewed alt text and short caption.

entries.credit: U.S. government photo, via CRS report RL33153 (R. O'Rourke) · Public domain · via Wikimedia Commons
entries.reason: Held by independent review of PR #418 (2026-10-12), pending evidence of original government authorship. Commons labels the file PD-US-Government and says it was provided to CRS by the Navy Office of Legislative Affairs, but supplying a photograph to CRS does not establish who made it, and the file's author field describes the CRS report, not the photographer. A Commons category plus a supplied-by attribution is not an original-author determination under the new-surface photograph standard. The alt text drafted for this surface ("underway on the surface") is not established by the available source description and must not be reused. The opened-article use of this image is a separate, unchanged surface. Clear only with original-photographer or originating-agency evidence and an alt text limited to what the source states.

B5 (DECISION_LOG 2026-10-10): the existing image stays only on its existing surfaces. Its attribution and image-to-article match are unresolved and its metadata note carries mismatched 81.cn text. No new surface may use it.
